item.title: Kafka Cross-Zone Transfer Cost
item.description: Spreading Kafka across zones creates cross-zone transfer charges on three paths: produce, replication, and consume. This covers how GCP and AWS bill that traffic, the path you can cut without changing placement (follower fetching), the trade-offs of per-zone clusters and two-zone placement, and controller quorum placement, then measures broker egress before and after follower fetching on a local Docker cluster.
